🦖 Jurassic Genesis 🦖 

🛠️ | This is the OFFICIAL re-release of Jurassic Genesis, carried on by various members of the original development team. We hope you enjoy what is to come for JG! | 🛠️

Welcome to Jurassic Genesis! This is a dinosaur game where you can roleplay and survive as many different dinosaurs. Meet new friends, encounter dinosaurs, and have fun exploring the expansive map ingame! From Microceratus to Spinosaurus, the choice is yours to play as! Or, play as a hunter and survive against the dinosaurs as a human.

Like for more updates!

Controls (PC):

1, 2, 3, 4 - Roars (Not every dino has a 4th roar!)
LMB - Primary
F - Ability
Q - Sit
Left Shift - Sprint

All creature models ingame are property of their respective owners. We are working very hard to replace any free assets/models in the game.

| Genesis Studios |
